statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6225 affects ACRCredHelper.Get and isACRRegistry in github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env. Direct go tool nm inspection of the published scout-sbom-indexer 1.23.1 binary for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 found the module's init and acrRE symbols but neither affected function. The entrypoint accepts BuildKit filesystem paths and constructs an fs:// source, so it does not invoke registry credential-helper flows. The vulnerable token-disclosure path is not executable in the shipped binary.

GO-2026-6225 affects ACRCredHelper.Get and isACRRegistry in github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env. Direct go tool nm inspection of the published scout-sbom-indexer 1.23.1 binary for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 found the module's init and acrRE symbols but neither affected function. The entrypoint accepts BuildKit filesystem paths and constructs an fs:// source, so it does not invoke registry credential-helper flows. The vulnerable token-disclosure path is not executable in the shipped binary.

GO-2026-6225 is a credential-leak flaw in ACRCredHelper.Get when resolving Azure Container Registry hostnames. kyverno-reports-server does not import github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env or invoke Docker credential helpers; the module is an indirect dependency from the cosign/kyverno chain and the vulnerable Get path is never executed.

GO-2026-6225 affects github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env, an indirect dependency embedded in the scout-cli binary via trivy. No fixed module version is published yet. Remediation depends on upstream scout-cli-plugin or trivy adopting a patched credential helper release.

GO-2026-6225 flags github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env, which has no fixed release in that module. The helper is linked through sigstore/cosign registry keychain wiring and go-containerregistry k8schain (OCIRepository reconciler calls k8schain.NewFromPullSecrets for user-configured registry URLs). A maintained fork (osscontainertools/docker-credential-acr v0.8.0) contains the anchored-regex fix, but a go.mod replace to that module fails with a dual module-path conflict during go mod tidy. Published sigstore/cosign v2 and v3 releases through v3.1.3 still depend on chrismellard. Under investigation pending upstream cosign migration or a compatible remediation.

GO-2026-6225 affects the unmaintained github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env module (no fixed release). Kubescape v4.0.12 pulls it in indirectly through helm.sh/helm/v3. Replacing it with github.com/gaganhr94/docker-credential-acr@v1.0.2 via go mod replace fails because helm also resolves the maintained module directly, producing a dual module-path conflict at go mod tidy. Until helm upstream drops the legacy import or kubescape can adopt a release that no longer needs it, the finding remains visible on v4 variants.
